zh: 新增尺寸矩阵检查（npm run matrix，并接入 npm run verify）：每个内置组件在代表性的看板盒子与缩略画面里检查横向溢出、空画面、被裁的可见控件与控制台错误。
en: Adds a size-matrix check (npm run matrix, wired into npm run verify): every built-in widget is checked in representative board boxes and the thumbnail view for horizontal overflow, an empty surface, clipped visible controls and console errors.
